title: Bulk Domain Availability Checks Need Clean Inputs and Final Rechecks

cover.h2: Need Clean Inputs and Final Rechecks
cover.subtitle: Turn a list into a reviewed shortlist.
cover.visual: A domain candidate list narrows through cleanup, status review, and a final recheck.

sections.name: 01-inputs
sections.heading: Clean inputs keep a bulk search focused on the intended names
sections.scene: A candidate spreadsheet passes through spelling cleanup and deduplication to a smaller exact-domain list. No real availability claims.
sections.alt: A clean domain list preserves exact intended spellings.

sections.name: 02-states
sections.heading: Availability results need more than a yes-or-no column
sections.scene: Four result bins with exact labels Candidate, Unavailable, Needs review, Unknown. A small clock icon beside each bin indicates checking time, but no numeric timestamp or actual domain result. No guarantee badge.
sections.alt: Availability review preserves unknown and special states.

sections.name: 03-api
sections.heading: An API workflow must preserve limits and per-domain errors
sections.scene: A bounded batch pipeline keeps successful rows and error rows in separate visible paths without secrets or request URLs.
sections.alt: A documented API workflow preserves row-level results and errors.

sections.name: 04-purchase
sections.heading: A purchase decision needs pricing and a fresh final check
sections.scene: A small shortlist passes registration, renewal, eligibility, and final spelling checks before a clearly separate approval gate.
sections.alt: A shortlist needs full cost review and a fresh final check.

purpose: Initial illustration plan. The final image review manifest records actual asset hashes and visual revisions.
